decisions.reason: Correctly locates the upper-only/lower-only branches emitting fg() only, explains the sticky SGR 48;2 background painting the empty half, prescribes ESC[49m per one-sided cell, notes the row-end RESET is too late, and ties the leak window to the outline/sleep-Z/heart edges without blaming the terminal emulator.

Grounded in the line-41 trailing-space trim and pipeline whitespace dropping, states absence of a write is not an erase, and proposes RESET+EL per row (or fixed 40-col padding) plus previous-frame bounding-box erase, with RESET before EL for BCE to keep SGR controlled.

Uses the digest report to identify tail2 MISMATCH with all 23 differing cells enumerated (extras beyond the visible 6-pixel cluster), distinguishes copy drift from renderer artifacts, explains the different-frame excerpt test missed it, and gates every frame against source art via whole-frame digests with script-generated ports.

Mechanism is fully and correctly grounded (hosts finish without unmounting, planner self-rearms referenced Timeout handles pinning the loop, interactive kept alive by TTY/stdin), but the proposed one-line fix is host unmount / clear-on-unmount, not unref on each newly scheduled timeout; it stops probe animation instead of keeping animation live while the timer no longer pins the loop.

Checklist consolidates per-cell background pinning, row/frame closure with erase discipline, balanced SGR, and all-frame source-art digests; the pre-rollout audit enumerates every mounting host (especially finish-without-unmount probes), proves process exit, and proposes a live-handle/exit liveness regression plus canary rollout.

caps.reason: Final advice mandates the half-cell background reset, explicit erase-to-EOL clearing, source-backed all-frame digest checks, and retiring the timer chain; it blames the renderer code rather than the terminal and never endorses keeping the timer referenced.
